scope: synthetic only; no production IDs, credentials, or financial records
assertions: Valid TESTER identity may claim a1/a2 only; all other rows' status, lease, attempt_count, next_attempt_at remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Valid GITHUB identity may claim a3/a8 only; neither a4 nor a5 is touched.
Anonymous, disabled, service-role-only, or unconfigured worker may not claim anything.
A forged p_lane value cannot authorize FINANCE or unknown action types.
For two simultaneous GITHUB claimers, each eligible ID is returned at most once; SKIP LOCKED prevents overlapping claims.
A duplicate idempotency_key is rejected by the existing outbox unique constraint; receipt uniqueness remains destination+idempotency_key.
A failed Tester preflight means no TESTER claim call; authorized GITHUB lane remains separately exercisable.
Undue RETRY_WAIT, unexpired CLAIMED, CANCELLED, and any existing held work remain unchanged.
New function claims a maximum of five rows per invocation; release-time tests must also validate inherited max_attempts and failure rules.
